name: synaptory
description: Native Synaptory delivery orchestration for Codex. Certified for SPQ (`build_mode: spq`); Scrum and Kanban are uncertified on this host, so warn and recommend SPQ.

interface.longDescription: A native Codex host package for Synaptory projects. Codex is certified for SPQ (`build_mode: spq`). Scrum and Kanban share the lifecycle kernel but are uncertified on this host, so the plugin warns before delivery dispatch and recommends SPQ.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $synaptory to inspect readiness and continue governed SPQ delivery with Codex agents. Recommend `build_mode: spq`; warn that Scrum and Kanban are uncertified on Codex.
